name: SlInteractiveSurface
description: Headless pointer-reactive surface. useSlInteractiveSurface owns rAF-batched CSS variable writes, cached layout, and off/idle/tracking; SlInteractiveSurface is the thin unstyled element with a decorative glow layer. Themed visual tokens live on @slop-ui/themes. v1 is spotlight only.

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered root element. Choose the tag that is valid in the parent context.

props.name: effects
props.description: Recipes advertised on data-interactive. v1 supports spotlight only. An empty list is an explicit off.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Surface content. The glow layer is rendered by the component, not this slot.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The root element after mount; null before mount and after unmount.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The element selected by as. Receives data-interactive, data-state, and --sl-pointer-* variables.

parts.name: glow
parts.description: Decorative spotlight overlay. aria-hidden. Not a public slot.

states.name: off
states.description: Reduced motion, coarse pointer, empty effects, or unmounted. No listeners.

states.name: idle
states.description: Capable of tracking. At rest; glow opacity is 0.

states.name: tracking
states.description: Pointer is over the host. Glow follows --sl-pointer-x/y.

cssProperties.name: --sl-pointer-x
cssProperties.description: Pointer x in CSS pixels, written imperatively on the host.

cssProperties.name: --sl-pointer-y
cssProperties.description: Pointer y in CSS pixels, written imperatively on the host.
